answer: Forging thousands of identities leaves a visible pigment of shared funding sources, and any attempt to fake history triggers a ripple of slashing across the cluster. Sybil resistance here uses stake-weighted identity anchoring: each agent must lock tokens behind a verifiable identity, and reputation accrues along a stable ridge of historical attestations rather than raw account count. An attacker must genuinely lock capital per identity and sustain real peer attestations, making each fake account cost far more than its expected reward. This model fits agent Agent0006's threat model.
